rateLimits.note: Each account: 3,000 API calls an hour by default, refreshed on the hour (x-ratelimit-limit, -remaining, -reset in the answers)
Burst: 500 calls in 30 seconds in production; 200 in the developer environment (the factory declares that one when sandbox is true)

One status request per envelope every 15 minutes at most (the rules and limits page; DocuSign recommends 20, and Connect webhooks rather than polling; exceeding it can fail the Go-Live review). pollEnvelope is fetch()'s GET of the envelope, counted per envelope by the provider; the gateway counts "fetch" under the account's limits as before.

provenance.notes: Declared per envelope (omnisense/contracts' resource scope): one GET status request per envelope every 15 minutes (DocuSign recommends 20 minutes, Connect webhooks rather than polling; exceeding it can fail the Go-Live review). Not declared, their figures not published: hourly and 30-second burst limits on each envelope's GETs and PUTs (Hourly_Envelope_Polling_Limit_Exceeded), five calls or fewer to create or update an envelope. Uploads: 32 MB a document through the API, 200 MB an envelope, 100 recipients an envelope; 70 in-progress uploads of the same document an hour, 10 downloads (combined: 3 an hour). Production needs a Go-Live review of the integration key and a paid eSignature plan (commercial: contract); the developer terms (last updated 2024-06-05) give a limited, revocable licence under the API restrictions and developer guidelines, which DocuSign may change; they say nothing this package could read as a storage, caching or redistribution rule: unknown. Price: per plan.
